entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ARM64: redundant store/load in generated constructor code #123078
  • [API Proposal]: Add EndiannessAwarePair<TUpper, TLower> #123073

Closed

  • Exception from Array.CreateInstance(typeof(object),new int[]{1},new int[]{Int32.MaxValue}) #51128
    Future
  • X509CertificateLoader.LoadPkcs12FromFile removes X509Certificate2.FriendlyName #123071
    Future
  • Problem if something said nethost.a/so but it said exception PlatformNotSupportedException Error in Dotnet 10 very latest #122981
  • Long running test: SynchronizationContextCurrent_NotUsedForAsyncOperations #53987
  • System.Timers.Timer may activate repeating timer in a way in which Stop() would not stop it #33119
    Future
  • Improve Code Coverage for System.Security.Cryptography.Xml (66.3%) #20508
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Handle RFC 6761 special-use domain names in Dns resolution #123076
    area-System.Net, community-contribution
  • Fix another Uri debug assert #123075
    area-System.Net, 11.0.0
  • Refactor process.cpp to eliminate vector dependency and shutdown race conditions #123074
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 143.0.7499.192, windows: 144.0.7559.59 #123072
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono

Merged

  • Fix System.Timers.Timer Stop() not working after setting AutoReset or Interval on disabled one-shot timer #122843
    area-System.ComponentModel
  • Improve code coverage for System.Security.Cryptography.Xml #120640
    area-System.Security, test-enhancement

Updated

  • Optimize file system enumeration pattern matching with specialized delegates #123041
    area-System.IO
  • Bring throw helpers to PUSH_COOP_PINVOKE_FRAME plan #123015
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Optimize more bound checks around logical operators #122263
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, reduce-unsafe
  • Emit task returning thunks in crossgen2 #122651
    area-crossgen2-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [Wasm RyuJIT] Initial writeup on the calling convention #122988
    arch-wasm, needs-area-label
  • Trim UnixFileSystemTypes to the values .NET runtime cares about. #122964
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • JIT: Devirtualize non-shared generic virtual methods #122023
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Add DOTNET_DbgCreateDumpToolPath to override createdump directory (NativeAOT only) #122989
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Runtime-async Exception.ToString() #122722
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, area-NativeAOT-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [release/9.0-staging] Fix ICustomQueryInterface implementation in CrossApartmentQueryInterface_NoDeadlock #122570
    test-enhancement, area-Interop-coreclr, 9.0.x
  • Add coalescence optimization for AsyncEnumerable Append/Prepend/Concat operations #122389
